title: com.matrixmedia.donation
description: Timeline event representing a viewer donation (Super Chat) during a MatrixMedia stream. Sent as a regular room message event (not state). The tier and color determine how the donation is rendered in the stream overlay.

donation_id.description: Unique donation identifier (UUID v4, lowercase hex with dashes).

stream_id.description: Identifier of the stream this donation is associated with.

donor_display_name.description: Display name of the donor as shown in the stream overlay.

amount_cents.description: Donation amount in the smallest currency unit (cents). Range: $1.00 to $100.00 equivalent.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (lowercase). Supported currencies for donations.

message.description: Optional donor message displayed alongside the donation in the stream overlay.

tier.description: Donation tier determining visual styling and pin duration. Tiers are ordered by amount: blue < green < yellow < orange < magenta < red < gold.

pin_duration_secs.description: Duration in seconds that the donation message is pinned in the stream overlay.

color.description: Hex color code for the donation overlay background (e.g. '#FFEB3B').

version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this version of the event schema.
